new.title: New session
new.description: A talk, class, workshop, or training. You'll add the interactions next.

cards.interactionsDescription: In the order they'll be presented. Use the eye icon to see what participants see.
cards.slidesDescription: Present from PulseStage: slides and questions in one sequence, no window switching.
cards.engagementDescription: Audience Q&A, live reactions, and moderation. You can also change these during the session, from the live room.
cards.raffleDescription: Optional. Give away prizes to people who answered the survey or to everyone who joined the session.

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: How AI is changing the job market
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What the session is about and who it's for.
form.localeHelp: The big screen and the audience's phones use this language, and so do the profanity filter and AI suggestions.
form.joinCodePlaceholder: E.g. AI2026 — leave blank to generate one automatically
form.joinCodeLocked: The code can't change once the session has started.
form.surveyLocked: The session already ended with this survey.
form.surveyHelp: The audience answers it when the session ends.
form.requiredHint: Only the title is required. You can adjust the rest later.
form.moreOptionsHint: Description, duration, language, join code and survey

controls.startConfirmDescription: This session doesn't have any interactions yet.
controls.deleteConfirmDescription: All session data (responses, feedback, insights) will be deleted. This can't be undone.
controls.duplicateDescription: The copy includes questions, slides, the survey, and giveaway prizes. Responses and participants stay with the original.
controls.rehearsalHint: Opens a live rehearsal to test with a phone; nothing from it counts in your stats.

slides.ready: {count, plural, one {# slide ready.} other {# slides ready.}}
slides.removeConfirmDescription: Your questions stay in the lineup. If you upload another PDF, they go back to the same spots.
slides.noSlidesReadOnly: This session was presented without slides.
slides.emptyTitle: Present your slides from here, no window switching
slides.emptyDescription: Upload your presentation PDF. Questions go between slides, and your clicker advances everything: slide, question, results, next slide.
slides.exportHelp: PowerPoint: File → Export → PDF · Google Slides: File → Download → PDF · Keynote: File → Export To → PDF · Canva: Share → Download → PDF. The PDF is converted in your browser; only the slide images are uploaded. Animations and videos aren't kept.
slides.summary: <num>{slides}</num> {slides, plural, one {slide} other {slides}} · {questions, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}.
slides.readOnlyHint: Each question comes in at the marked spot.
slides.editHint: Drag questions to the point in the presentation where they should come in, or use each one's selector.

errors.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the slides. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooLarge: The PDF is over {max} MB. Export it with compressed images.
errors.openFailed: Couldn't open the PDF. It may be password-protected or corrupted.
errors.tooManyPages: The PDF has {total} pages; the limit is {max}.
errors.encodeFailed: Your browser couldn't create the slide images.
errors.incompleteUpload: Some slides didn't finish uploading. Try again.
errors.notLive: Start or resume the session to show slides.

raffle.enable: Run a giveaway in this session
raffle.enableHelp: Everyone who's entered gets a random number on their phone. In the live room, the “Giveaway” card puts the drawing on the big screen, with suspense and sound, and shows the winner's name, number, and avatar.
raffle.entrants: {entrants, plural, one {# person entered} other {# people entered}} so far.
raffle.entrantsOf: {entrants, plural, one {# person entered} other {# people entered}} so far, out of {participants, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}.
raffle.surveyNote: The survey opens when you end the session; the live room stays open for the giveaway.
raffle.emptyDescription: Add what you'll give away: a book, a mentoring session, a coupon… Physical or digital.
raffle.winnersOf: {drawn} of {quantity, plural, one {# winner} other {# winners}}
raffle.deleteConfirmWithWinners: Winners already drawn for it will also be removed from the list.
raffle.legalNote: Each person can win at most one prize. The drawing happens on the server, with a cryptographic random number generator, before the big screen starts the animation. Promotional giveaways run by companies may require prior authorization under local law; check before announcing one.

form.name: Prize
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown on the big screen with the prize
form.messagePlaceholderDigital: Coupon code, redemption link, or how to claim it
form.messagePlaceholderPhysical: Where and when to pick up the prize
form.messageHelp: Shown only on the winner's phone, after the big screen reveals it.

errors.prizeFull: All winners for this prize have already been drawn.
errors.raffleDisabled: This session doesn't have a giveaway.
errors.unavailable: Start the session and set up the giveaway first.
errors.showFailed: Couldn't update the giveaway on the big screen.

qa_enabled.label: Audience Q&A
qa_enabled.description: An “Ask the speaker” button on phones. The audience can upvote each other's questions.

qa_moderated.label: Approve questions before they appear
qa_moderated.description: New questions wait until you approve them in the live room.

reactions_enabled.label: Live reactions
reactions_enabled.description: 👏 ❤️ 😂 😮 🤔 on phones during the session; the emojis float up on the big screen.

profanity_filter.label: Profanity filter
profanity_filter.description: Word cloud entries, open-ended answers, and questions with profanity stay off the big screen. You can see them and let them through.

moderate_open_text.label: Approve open-ended answers before the big screen
moderate_open_text.description: Each open-ended answer waits for your approval before it appears on the big screen.

errors.invalidJoinCode: The code must be 4 to 10 letters or numbers.
errors.joinCodeLocked: The code can only be changed before the session starts.
errors.joinCodeTaken: That code is already in use.
